classes.cause: The chosen long pytest basetemp makes an AF_UNIX path exceed the platform limit.
The test intentionally expects four already-loaded BLAS threads; the wrapper constrained affinity to two CPUs, and OpenBLAS started two.
classes.next_check: Use at least four allowed CPUs for these short runtime tests.

classes.next_check: Keep the production accounting unchanged; give the wall-only synthetic fixture an explicit CPU clock and test its process timeout/retry protections.
